name: dsh-theme-admech
description: Pure Forge-Cathedral tech-gothic theme for DSH. v0.9.2 removes the always-visible cogitation-depth progress bar from the composer (reasoning effort stays adjustable through the discrete slider in the model menu) and makes placeholder hiding deterministic for layout audits. v0.9.1: themed expanded command-row icons. v0.9.0: themed macOS application icon (install/restore scripts), readable recommendation badge, Mars-red primary button in queue/steer/stop states. v0.8.0: one-piece boot prelude takeover, machine-spirit telemetry rail, reasoning slider. v0.7.x: Windows fixes, DPI-aware hairlines. macOS + Windows verified. 机械神教 · 铸炉圣殿。
